column1: # Unit revert map: new<TAB>old  (inverse of map-unit-noarg.tsv)
# Purpose: undo the Unit no-arg batch as ONE operation, so a failed batch never needs
# hand-editing again. Use with the symbol-resolved tool, not with regexes:
# The tool also renames the override family, so reversing getSortValue() puts
# Sortable.c() / PositionedSortable.c() / Site.c() back together with Unit.c().
# Prior batches (UserConfig / GameConfig / AbstractGameInfo) are untouched.
